title: God Does Not Play Dice: Enforcing Batch Invariance in Agentic Kernel Generation
abstract: arXiv:2610.36623v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language model (LLM) serving systems dynamically batch user requests for GPU execution, so the same request may be processed alongside different requests across runs. If the GPU kernels lack batch invariance (BI), this changing batch context can alter the numerical output for an unchanged input, undermining reproducibility. Existing kernel generation agents focus on correctness and efficiency but \emph{overlook BI}. We find 19 confirmed BI violations among 83 batch-applicable released artifacts. To address this limitation, we propose \tool, which combines contract-guided static dependency analysis with dynamic validation of bitwise consistency across batch contexts. \tool is designed as a plug-in component for general kernel agents, allowing their original optimization capabilities to be reused while adding BI enforcement. translated_title: 上帝不掷骰子：在智能体式内核生成中强制执行批处理不变性
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）服务系统会动态地将用户请求分批以进行GPU执行，因此同一请求在不同运行中可能会与不同的请求一起被处理。如果GPU内核缺乏批处理不变性，这种不断变化的批处理上下文可能会改变相同输入的数值输出，从而损害可复现性。现有的内核生成智能体专注于正确性和效率，却忽视了批处理不变性。我们在83个适用于批处理的已发布产物中发现了19个经确认的批处理不变性违规。为解决这一局限，我们提出了一个工具，它将基于契约的静态依赖分析与跨批处理上下文的按位一致性动态验证相结合。该工具被设计为通用内核智能体的即插即用组件，能够在复用其原有优化能力的同时增加批处理不变性强制执行。我们将其作为优化循环中的连续验收门控进行集成，拒绝结构上有风险或动态验证不通过的内核（摘要原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种即插即用工具，通过将契约引导的静态依赖分析与跨批处理上下文的按位一致性动态验证相结合，作为验收门控嵌入内核生成智能体的优化循环中，从而强制执行批处理不变性，解决LLM服务中动态批处理导致相同输入产生不同数值输出、损害可复现性的问题。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes a plug-in tool that enforces batch invariance in kernel generation agents by combining contract-guided static dependency analysis with dynamic bitwise consistency validation across batch contexts, integrated as successive acceptance gates in the optimization loop, thereby solving the reproducibility problem where dynamic batching in LLM serving causes identical inputs to yield different numerical outputs.
